shared_elements: curled hair rendered as rows of small ringlets
low relief carving of human subject
stylised almond eye shown frontally in profile head
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile with headgear and hair/beard conventionalised into regular rows of tight curls or beads, and both use shallow relief with the eye stylised; this is a fairly specific shared convention for rendering the head. However, A shows a full-length procession of multiple standing figures carrying vessels and interacting (hand-holding, facing a seated/standing dignitary) under a rosette band, while B is a single isolated head-and-shoulders with no scene, no accompanying objects, and no compositional relationships.
